text_block_list.text: It happened one day after having raced through the Twinkle Series and settling things down.
On this day, fulfilling Sweep Tosho's long-standing wish, I was showing her grandmother around the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Grandma!!
This is my academy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, everywhere I look brings back so many memories~

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking the trouble
to guide me, Trainer.
Even worrying about my transportation...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez. Grandma, don't stop walking!
There are still things I want to show you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is there something you'd like to show me?
Let's see, what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to wait until we get there to find out!
Heheh, this way, this way!♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look, Grandma!!
These girls are my apprentices!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Well, well... Sweepy!
Did you go and take an apprentice?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Come on, everyone,
bow to Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: H-Hello there! Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Thank you for always taking such good care of me~.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what is this situation!?
When on earth did we become Sweep's apprentices!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Shh, Vodka!
Sweep's grandmother is right there!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep wants to show her grandmother her best side too.
You should read between the lines
and help her out!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Both of you, stop squabbling, you're being so noisy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it wonderful, Sweepy!
Your apprentices being so full of energy is proof of
what a great and magnanimous witch their master is.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"And thank you all
for getting along so well with Sweepy, you hear?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-No, the pleasure is all mine! And besides...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come now, wrap up the chitchat!
Next, we're going to show Grandma
us racing together!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, guide Grandma
to the best seat!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Looks like Sweepy
has made lots and lots of friends too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: ...To the point where there's nothing left to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes. At first, I was worried whether Sweepy
would be able to fit in at the academy.
She's exceptionally honest, yet so shy around strangers, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I was concerned that some girls
might get the wrong impression of her, too."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
“It seems those fears were unfounded, though.
Look how many friends... have gathered around her.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san.
Are you training with everyone today?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want in too, Rob Roy?
We're just about to do a one-lap race!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...A match.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll go change right away!
...Because I want to beat Sweep-san, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Rob Roy-san is joining
as an opponent too!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Racing against two of the strongest out of nowhere...
I'm not ready for that at all...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Scarlet, getting cold feet?
'Cause I'm totally chilling over here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I'm the Umamusume who's gonna win the Derby, after all. A race against you two is the perfect warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wh...! I do, too!
I have goals of my own, too—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ? What is it, Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, everyone!
If you do not stop fighting,
I shall have to tap you with my fists!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Preparations... are complete...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So fast?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, take your marks!
Here we go, ready...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: BAM!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: First plaaace!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, that acceleration is unreal...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah!? We have an emergency, an emergency!
Vodka-san, hop onto my back!
I shall whisk you away to the infirmary in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
K-Kawakami-san!?
Please don't worry. I believe Vodka just has a buildup of lactic acid...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! Sweepy!
You sure managed to catch quite
a colorful bunch of apprentices!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, Grandma!
Heh, aren't I just the greatest?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's still got a long way to go, though,
so I'm training them a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. Sweepy's special training looks awfully
intense. I hope her apprentice doesn't end up
running away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...! You're running away!?
Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wha, why me!?
............*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep is a genuinely sweet girl,
and above all, someone I truly respect."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the Grand Prix just like she did.
I want to run the ultimate race, one that leaves a vivid, lasting impression on everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Oho...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Looks like Sweepy really went and got herself an apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma, you're leaving already~?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a shame,
looks like my train has arrived to pick me up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no need to feel lonely, Sweepy.
Next time, why don't you come over to my place to play?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
You can bring your friends, your disciples,
even your Trainer, anyone at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. Of course.
I shall tidy up the house thoroughly.”

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: "And then... you'll watch over the growth of your 'racing magic,' just like raising an apprentice."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
You've changed the world with the magic of racing. Just like that girl back then.
A true witch takes responsibility and sees things through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Her running will be passed down to the next generation

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... I'm counting on you,
Trainer. With you by my side,
I feel completely at ease.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Sweepy.
Make sure you enjoy the present to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Grandma!
Ehehe, see you soon!

Sweep Tosho's grandmother
kept bowing repeatedly while glancing back over and over.

"Standing alongside Sweep Tosho,
we waved our hands at her back over and over again."
